# PR #1924: Patch: layered summons and the lethal guard for Units

Closes #1842

## What changed

The engine has a new effect, `summon_pile` (kind `"summonPile"`), in `crates/engine/src/effects/summon.rs`. It summons several Units into one unit zone as a §3.2 Stack pile. The first card listed goes at the bottom and the last goes on top, so the top is fought first. This is the Drone Battleship: Meltdown at the bottom, then Propagation, then the Shield on top.

- **Choosing the zone:** the bottom card takes the zone any summon would take: a named lane, else the leftmost open zone, else the leftmost empty Locked zone (`zone_for`, R64, R688). Each later card is placed on top of it, Stack keyword or not. If there is no zone, nothing is summoned.
- **Each card is its own summon:** no Cry, its own `summoned` event, summoning sick, and Radiant when the pile is.
- **Non-Units:** a card that is not a Unit is skipped. Without this check it would be set into the backrow.
- **Pausing:** the chosen lane is kept in the effect's memo (the same pattern as `recruit_all`). So if a card asks a question as it arrives (R151), the rest of the pile resumes onto the same zone (R113).
- **Lethal guard:** R1204's lethal guard already works on Units. The new tests prove it on a pile, where it guards only while it is the top card.

Nothing else in `crates/engine/src` changed. `effects/mod.rs`'s `pub use summon::*` already puts the verb in the prelude.

There is no new state, event, prompt or action. So there is nothing to add to `ANIMATIONS` or `SOUND_CUES`, and no work for the AI, the random policy, the timeout or `legalActions`. The client's existing pile display (`StackSheet`, `UnitView.buried`) already renders the pile from `viewFor` alone. A test checks that both seats see the top card and `buried == 2`, never the cards beneath (rule 7). No card calls the verb yet; the Stinkyscape cards come in S07 and S22.

**Spec:**
- New rulings `R1842000` (layered summon) and `R1842001` (a lethal guard in a pile guards only while on top).
- Edits to §3.2 (Stack bullet), §4.4 (step 4a), §6.2 (Replacement row), §6.3 (Summon row), and two paragraphs in §11.
- `spec/INDEX.md` regenerated.

## Tests

`crates/engine/tests/rules/layered_summons.rs` has 13 tests, using fixture cards in `fixtures/layered_summons.rs` (ids `ls-`, indices from 18420). They cover:
- bottom-first order and the view;
- the leftmost open zone, and a full row that summons nothing;
- a named lane that is free, Locked, taken or reserved;
- the leftmost empty Locked zone;
- the Radiant face;
- a non-Unit card being skipped;
- a destroy-everything effect reaching only the top, with each layer resuming in turn;
- a reaction to a lower layer's summon finding that layer dormant;
- a pause on arrival resuming onto the same zone, with the paused state surviving a JSON round trip;
- the guard on top catching a lethal hit on an ally, and on its hero;
- a lethal hit on the guard itself not being redirected;
- a guard beneath the top catching nothing until it is uncovered.

As a mutation check, I made the effect ignore its memo, and the pause test failed (`left: ["ls-asker"]`). I then restored the code.

/// `summonPile`'s arguments.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Default)]
#[cfg_attr(feature = "ts", derive(ts_rs::TS))]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct SummonPileArgs {
    /// The pile's cards, bottom first; the last is its top, the one that acts (§3.2).
    pub def_ids: Vec<String>,
    /// Who controls the pile; its owner too, as its cards are created here (R12).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub player: Option<PlayerSpec>,
    /// A named lane; nothing is summoned when that zone is occupied or reserved (R47).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub lane: Option<i32>,
    /// Every card of the pile is Radiant (the Radiant Drone Battleship's layers).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub radiant: Option<bool>,
}

/// R1842000: a layered summon, `def_ids` summoned into one unit zone as a §3.2 Stack pile, first at
/// the bottom, last on top (the Drone Battleship's layers, so the Shield is fought first). The bottom
/// takes the zone a summon takes (`zone_for`, R64, R688) and each later card is summoned onto it as
/// the new top, Stack or not; with no such zone nothing is summoned. Each card is its own summon (no
/// Cry, R1), and a definition that is not a Unit is passed over. The zone is the part's memo, so a
/// question a card asks as it arrives (R151) pauses the rest, which resumes onto the same zone (R113).
pub fn summon_pile(args: SummonPileArgs) -> Effect {
    lazy_part("summonPile", move |ctx, memo| {
        let player = player_of(ctx, args.player.unwrap_or(PlayerSpec::SelfSide));
        let remembered = memo
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(Value::as_i64)
            .and_then(|lane| i32::try_from(lane).ok());
        let lane = match remembered {
            Some(lane) => lane,
            None => {
                let at = SummonPlacement {
                    lane: args.lane,
                    ..SummonPlacement::default()
                };
                let Some(slot) = zone_for(ctx, player, Row::Units, &at) else {
                    return EffectPart::default();
                };
                slot.lane
            }
        };
        let source_id = ctx.self_.as_ref().map(|me| me.id.clone());
        let effects: Vec<Effect> = args
            .def_ids
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(index, def_id)| {
                let def_id = def_id.clone();
                let placement = SummonPlacement {
                    lane: Some(lane),
                    stack: (index > 0).then_some(true),
                    radiant: args.radiant,
                    source_id: source_id.clone(),
                    ..SummonPlacement::default()
                };
                Effect::new("summonPileCard", move |at| {
                    let probe = face_probe(&def_id, player, placement.radiant == Some(true));
                    if card_type_of(at.state, &probe) != CardType::Unit {
                        return;
                    }
                    summon_fresh(at, &def_id, player, &placement);
                })
            })
            .collect();
        EffectPart {
            effects,
            memo: Some(json!(lane)),
        }
    })
}

/// `summonPile`'s arguments.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Default)]
#[cfg_attr(feature = "ts", derive(ts_rs::TS))]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct SummonPileArgs {
    /// The pile's cards, bottom first; the last is its top, the one that acts (§3.2).
    pub def_ids: Vec<String>,
    /// Who controls the pile; its owner too, as its cards are created here (R12).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub player: Option<PlayerSpec>,
    /// A named lane; nothing is summoned when that zone is occupied or reserved (R47).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub lane: Option<i32>,
    /// Every card of the pile is Radiant (the Radiant Drone Battleship's layers).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub radiant: Option<bool>,
}

/// R1842000: a layered summon, `def_ids` summoned into one unit zone as a §3.2 Stack pile, first at
/// the bottom, last on top (the Drone Battleship's layers, so the Shield is fought first). The bottom
/// takes the zone a summon takes (`zone_for`, R64, R688) and each later card is summoned onto it as
/// the new top, Stack or not; with no such zone nothing is summoned. Each card is its own summon (no
/// Cry, R1), and a definition that is not a Unit is passed over. The zone is the part's memo, so a
/// question a card asks as it arrives (R151) pauses the rest, which resumes onto the same zone (R113).
pub fn summon_pile(args: SummonPileArgs) -> Effect {
    lazy_part("summonPile", move |ctx, memo| {
        let player = player_of(ctx, args.player.unwrap_or(PlayerSpec::SelfSide));
        let remembered = memo
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(Value::as_i64)
            .and_then(|lane| i32::try_from(lane).ok());
        let lane = match remembered {
            Some(lane) => lane,
            None => {
                let at = SummonPlacement {
                    lane: args.lane,
                    ..SummonPlacement::default()
                };
                let Some(slot) = zone_for(ctx, player, Row::Units, &at) else {
                    return EffectPart::default();
                };
                slot.lane
            }
        };
        let source_id = ctx.self_.as_ref().map(|me| me.id.clone());
        let effects: Vec<Effect> = args
            .def_ids
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(index, def_id)| {
                let def_id = def_id.clone();
                let placement = SummonPlacement {
                    lane: Some(lane),
                    stack: (index > 0).then_some(true),
                    radiant: args.radiant,
                    source_id: source_id.clone(),
                    ..SummonPlacement::default()
                };
                Effect::new("summonPileCard", move |at| {
                    let probe = face_probe(&def_id, player, placement.radiant == Some(true));
                    if card_type_of(at.state, &probe) != CardType::Unit {
                        return;
                    }
                    summon_fresh(at, &def_id, player, &placement);
                })
            })
            .collect();
        EffectPart {
            effects,
            memo: Some(json!(lane)),
        }
    })
}

/// R1842000: a layered summon, `def_ids` summoned into one unit zone as a §3.2 Stack pile, first at
/// the bottom, last on top (the Drone Battleship's layers, so the Shield is fought first). The bottom
/// takes the zone a summon takes (`zone_for`, R64, R688) and each later card is summoned onto it as

pub fn summon_pile(args: SummonPileArgs) -> Effect {
    lazy_part("summonPile", move |ctx, memo| {
        let player = player_of(ctx, args.player.unwrap_or(PlayerSpec::SelfSide));
        let remembered = memo
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(Value::as_i64)
            .and_then(|lane| i32::try_from(lane).ok());
        let lane = match remembered {
            Some(lane) => lane,
            None => {
                let at = SummonPlacement {
                    lane: args.lane,
                    ..SummonPlacement::default()
                };
                let Some(slot) = zone_for(ctx, player, Row::Units, &at) else {
                    return EffectPart::default();
                };
                slot.lane
            }
        };
        let source_id = ctx.self_.as_ref().map(|me| me.id.clone());
        let effects: Vec<Effect> = args
            .def_ids
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(index, def_id)| {
                let def_id = def_id.clone();
                let placement = SummonPlacement {
                    lane: Some(lane),
                    stack: (index > 0).then_some(true),
                    radiant: args.radiant,
                    source_id: source_id.clone(),
                    ..SummonPlacement::default()
                };
                Effect::new("summonPileCard", move |at| {
                    let probe = face_probe(&def_id, player, placement.radiant == Some(true));
                    if card_type_of(at.state, &probe) != CardType::Unit {
                        return;
                    }
                    summon_fresh(at, &def_id, player, &placement);
                })
            })
            .collect();
        EffectPart {
            effects,
            memo: Some(json!(lane)),
        }
    })
}
